faqs.q: Sec. 18-496. - I.P.M.C. Section 302.9, Defacement of property.
faqs.a:
Section 302.9. Defacement of property,
is hereby amended by adding a sentence to the end of the second paragraph to read
               as follows:
"All unlawful acts of graffiti defacement shall be charged in accordance with article
                  VI, Graffiti, of
chapter 62
, Offenses, of the Arvada City Code. All proceedings to determine or abate graffiti
                  vandalism shall be held in accordance with article IV, Graffiti, of
chapter 38
, Environment, of the Arvada City Code."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
